about_the_game:
Right On Time

You arrive at the Madam's Academy, a once-prestigious boarding school for witches, reduced to a echo of its former splendor. With neither heart nor hand left to tend it, many promising young witches have been turned away, and the manor has slipped into quiet disarray. The chandeliers struggle to hold back the shadows, furniture is coated in thick dust, and where magick once flourished, a darkness occupies its place. You were summoned here as the new butler, a title that feels more like a curse than an honor.

The witches you serve are beautiful, strange, and untouched by the decay that grips the manor. One welcomes you with warmth, the others see you as an intruder. Beneath the surface of it all lies a tangled web of power, pride, and rivalry.

To endure here you must tend to your duties, earn the trust (or affection) of the residents, and uncover the truth behind the darkness that stalks the manor's halls. As the days pass you'll decide how to spend your time: serve tea in the library, explore forbidden wings, study lost grimoires, chase shadows through the candlelit hallways or steal a quiet moment with one of the witches.

Every sunset the shadows grow stronger and the balance of magick fades.

The Residents

The Madam - The enigmatic headmistress recruits raw young potential, turning them into masters of their craft or breaking their spirit in the process. Behind her elegance and poise hides an unbridled edge and secrets only a dead man could keep. 

The Necromancer - Awkward, callous, and endlessly curious about what lies beyond the veil. To her, death is merely an inconvenience but also the answer to all her questions. However, knowledge of the dead is meaningless once you cross over, so she's long since abandoned her morals in pursuit of the truth.

The Alchemist - Passionate, methodical, and completely without magick. She plumbs the depths of the material world in search of the prima materia and the promise of a panacea. Outcast by nature, her obsessive curiosity and relentless dedication to the science earned her a place in the manor, yet even she fears her own self-doubt will be her undoing.

The Demonologist - Reserved, precise and tempered by noble lineage, she holds herself to impossible standards, accepting nothing less than perfection. To command the demons of hell, one must be unwavering in their emotional constitution and possess an utterly unbreakable will, qualities which she has in abundance.

And More...

Key Features

  • Magick is in the Air - Pursue heartfelt or haunting relationships with a cast of curious witches, each guarding their own secrets.

  • Retro-Adventure Spirit - Investigate rooms, uncover mysteries, collect clues, and interact through classic point-and-click- exploration inspired by the legacy of PC-98 adventure games.

  • Branching Paths & Endings - Every decision, question, and affection alters your path. Discover new routes, endings, and revelations with each new playthrough.

  • Multilayered Narrative - Unravel the forgotten history of the manor and its brooding Madam, confront the power that festers behind its beauty.

  • Gothic Atmospheric Style - Hand-crafted pixel art, moody soundscapes and a hauntingly romantic atmosphere bring this world to life.

content_descriptors.notes: Some narratives and plot lines involve topics surrounding the loss of loved ones and the potential ill fate of your avatar.

short_description: Witches’ Butler is a narrative-driven dating sim that combines elements of retro style adventure games with a spellbinding story. Tend to the resident witches, find romance, unravel the manor’s mysteries, and restore its fading magick. Every choice shapes the fate of the house, and your own heart.
